name: itservices-crm
description: Multi-tenant IT Services CRM, email automation, call management, and follow-up system

scripts.build: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run build -w @crm/web && npm run build -w @crm/worker
scripts.build:worker: npm run build -w @crm/shared && npm run build -w @crm/worker
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @crm/web && npm run lint -w @crm/worker && npm run lint -w @crm/shared
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @crm/shared && npm run typecheck -w @crm/web && npm run typecheck -w @crm/worker
